header.title: The Battle of Berlin
header.hook: Three weeks, two and a half million Soviet soldiers, one city.
header.outro: Six days after Berlin fell, the war in Europe was over.
header.footnote: Fronts simplified; losses interpolated between sourced totals.

events.title: Seelow and the Neisse
events.text: Zhukov attacks on the Oder; Konev crosses the Neisse.

events.title: Seelow broken
events.text: The last line before Berlin falls after four days.

events.title: Hitler's birthday
events.text: His last. Soviet long-range guns open fire on Berlin.

events.title: Berlin's edge
events.text: Soviet troops cross the city limits; Zossen is overrun.

events.title: Sachsenhausen
events.text: Soviet troops liberate the concentration camp.

events.title: Halbe
events.text: The German 9th Army is encircled south-east of Berlin.

events.title: Elbe Day
events.text: US and Soviet troops meet at Torgau. Germany is cut in two.

events.title: Stettin falls
events.text: Rokossovsky breaks through in the north.

events.title: Inside Berlin
events.text: The defenders hold a strip about 16 km long.

events.title: Wenck
events.text: The 12th Army's relief attack stalls at Lake Schwielow.

events.title: Moltke Bridge
events.text: Soviet troops cross the Spree near the Reichstag.

events.title: The bunker
events.text: Hitler kills himself. A Soviet flag goes up on the Reichstag.

events.title: Breakout
events.text: 9th Army survivors reach Wenck's lines near Beelitz.
